antidote.desc: Vents friction heat, restoring 10 health and boosting drive.
antidote.name: Cooling Coolant

friendship_key.desc: Won from friend challenges. Three open a friendship chest.
friendship_key.name: Friendship Key

hp_m.desc: High-purity clockwork oil, swiftly restoring 55 health.
hp_m.name: High-Purity Lubricant

hunt_bone.desc: Mid-tier hunting ground component. A sturdy heat-forged drive shaft.
hunt_bone.name: Forge Axis

hunt_core.desc: Rare hunting ground core. Best price at the surplus buyback.
hunt_core.name: Spill Core

hunt_hide.desc: Metal plating detached in the hunting grounds. Redeem at surplus buyback for gold.
hunt_hide.name: Overflow Plating

iron_scrap.desc: Basic forging material. Both the smith and the shop buy it.
iron_scrap.name: Scrap Iron

key_rusty.desc: The one you picked up at the mist-gallery mouth. Kept even after it was forged proper.
key_rusty.name: Rusty Sword (keepsake)

rusty_blade.desc: A mottled iron blade. Can be taken to Celestial Smith for forging.
rusty_blade.name: Rusty Sword

knight_shard.desc: A forging fragment from the knights' domain. Makes the sabre line.
knight_shard.name: Knight Iron Shard

map_scrap.desc: A corner the trader tore off for you. Good to look at, not to eat.
map_scrap.name: Six-Domain Map Scrap

medal.desc: Training-yard merit. 50 light the workshop furnace.
medal.name: Medal

mist_shard.desc: Dropped by mist shades. Sells for 12 gold.
mist_shard.name: Mist Crystal

oak_resin.desc: Material for stabilising and for accessories.
oak_resin.name: Oak Resin

relic_token.desc: A mark left from clearing a hidden place. For the collection.
relic_token.name: Secret Place Token

scar_ember.desc: Dropped in the scar. Sells for 15 gold.
scar_ember.name: Scar Ember

sea_shell.desc: Found on the coast. Sells for 10 gold.
sea_shell.name: Tide Shell

star_ore.desc: Micro-resonant crystal sand used in soul summoning and weapon forging.
star_ore.name: Clockwork Crystal Sand

windup_fragment.desc: A gear tooth dropped while winding up toys. Collect them to unlock monologues.
windup_fragment.name: Windup Fragment

wolf_fang.desc: A sharp component dropped by rogue automatons. Sells for 8 gold.
wolf_fang.name: Ratchet Tooth
